sourceDocuments.title: Reclaiming the African Narrative: The Poetics of Chinua Achebe
sourceDocuments.text: In Things Fall Apart, Chinua Achebe challenges colonial anthropological discourse by depicting pre-colonial Igbo society as a complex, structured civilization with sophisticated juridical customs, communal decision-making assemblies, and rich oral traditions.
